description.value: The Hard Bean Brunch Co is an all-day brunch restaurant with multiple BC locations, including this Willoughby–Langley outpost, founded by hospitality industry veteran Heather Rhodes. The concept bridges casual fine dining and breakfast, serving all-day brunch items alongside cocktails, curated wine flights, and BC craft beers on tap from local breweries. The welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere is designed to carry the brunch feeling from morning through evening.
